messages:
sanjay: Heads up — scheduling a non-invasive thermal probe + GPU microcontroller reset across edge-gpu cohorts in APAC-west1. Window: Tue 2026-04-07 00:00-02:00 UTC. Expect rolling soft node drains and brief (~2-3 min) microcontroller reboots per host.

liz: ACK. Which pools exactly? Are Dedicated/Dedicated-reserved pools impacted?

sanjay: Affected: edge-saturn-pool-1 (preemptible) and edge-saturn-pool-2 (shared-burst). Dedicated customer pools are excluded unless overflow triggers. We'll route burst to us-central as fallback.

marta: Last time we saw KV cache cold starts spike p99 latency. What's the mitigation this time?

ramon: Plan: pre-seed KV cache on standby nodes via kvseed job ~30m prior. Also ensure continuous-batching fallback is enabled for short tails.

kevin: Quick cost flag: if backfill goes to hosted, estimate extra outbound token cost for the window — I’ll post numbers.

liz: @kevin please post estimate. deploy-bot: maintenance ticket created: MO-2387 — https://redwood.atlassian/issue/MO-2387

sanjay: kvseed command (run from infra-runbook):
```bash
python infra/kvseed.py --pool edge-saturn-pool-1 --seed 0.8 --timeout 1800
```

marta: Add a canary: 5 nodes in eu-west3 to validate the microcontroller reset before any APAC-wide rollout. If errors or latency regressions >0.5% abort.

ramon: Routing note: set canary policy to latency-first, full rollout to cost-first fallback. That preserves latency SLAs for sensitive tenants.

kevin: Finance quick calc: delta ~= hosted_tokens * $0.012/token * est 90k tokens -> ~$1,080. I'll confirm on #finance.

liz: Customer comm draft for Reserved/Dedicated tenants: "Planned edge maintenance Tue 2026-04-07 00:00-02:00 UTC affecting burst/edge pools. Minimal impact expected; fallback to regional pools enabled. Contact support if SLA concerns." Thoughts?

marta: Also: do NOT fully suspend autoscalers. Suspending caused massive hosted backfill last time. Suggest cap maxSurge to 20% for the window.

sanjay: Agreed. Set cluster.autoscaler.maxSurge = 0.2 for the maintenance window. Also pause heavy model-quantization and eval jobs during the window to reduce IO and noise.

liz: Ops timeline (tentative):
- 00:00 start eu-west3 canary (5 nodes)
- 00:20 perf check + 10m buffer
- 00:30 begin APAC edge pools in 5-min staggered cohorts
- 01:50 final validation
- 02:00 window end
Who’s oncall?

ramon: Oncall: liz, marta. Sanjay will lead prep. Kevin on cost standby. I’ll monitor network/egress.

kevin: I’ll post final cost delta to #finance 30m before start.

marta: Checklist added to MO-2387: kvseed run, canary perf check, autoscaler cap, comms sent, backfill routing verify, rollback playbook attached.

liz: Rollback playbook (short):
```text
if error_rate_increase > 0.5%:
  - stop rollout
  - re-add nodes to active pool (undo drain)
  - route traffic back to previous region
  - escalate to infra oncall
```

sanjay: One more: disable heavy synthetic evals and long-running batch jobs during the window to avoid false positives in perf metrics. :no_entry_sign:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: maintenance MO-2387 will run Tue 2026-04-07 00:00 UTC. Automated canary trigger set for 60 minutes before start.

liz: Good plan. I’ll post the customer advisory and lock the autoscaler cap. :thumbsup:
